reason: My bookkeeper already puts everything into the expense app we use and it works well enough. I might throw a few scooter repair receipts at the free 30 to see what happens, but I wouldn't pay $19 a month for a second place for the same numbers.
objection: Half my spending is cash to mechanics with a scribbled note or no receipt at all, so I doubt a bot can tell a real duplicate from two identical tyre changes on two scooters. If it can't, it's just a receipt-to-table bot sitting next to the app I already have.
would_change_my_mind: If it pushed straight into my existing expense app (or my bookkeeper's) instead of a separate Google sheet, and showed me in the free trial that it really caught a duplicate my staff sent twice.
